name: Butcher's Cleaver
description: Weapon the Chronomaton used to sever Bazzle's arm and head.

description_citations.text: "Bazzle". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Chronomaton severs Bazzle's good arm, then decapitates him with the cleaver and replaces his head with its own mechanical one, completing itself.
timeline.quote: The golem then used the butcher's cleaver to decapitate Bazzle's head from its body
